items.title: Oil drops more than 3% on report U.S. plans to return evacuated diplomats to Middle East
items.description: Investors shrugged off the latest developments in the U.S.-Iran war.

items.title: Nvidia’s dependence on hyperscalers faces big test in earnings report
items.description: Nvidia is trying to expand its customer base by creating new financing options that allow for more clients to purchase its costly systems.

items.title: SEC reportedly subpoenas Wall Street banks over AI hedge fund Situational Awareness's near collapse
items.description: The SEC is seeking information from major Wall Street banks about trades and financing tied to AI-focused hedge fund Situational Awareness.

items.title: Dick's Sporting Goods stock falls 15% as retailer misses expectations, cites 'challenging' footwear market
items.description: Dick's Sporting Goods reported second fiscal quarter earnings on Tuesday that missed Wall Street expectations amid what it called a "challenging" environment.

items.title: United Airlines adds 2027 flights spanning Sardinia to Okinawa. Here's what it says about travel today
items.description: United is betting big on premium, international travel with a host of new routes.

items.title: Bugatti CEO Mate Rimac says the future of supercars is old-school combustion engines
items.description: Bugatti CEO Mate Rimac told CNBC he thinks high-end sports cars will continue to have combustion engines "for a very long time" even with the rise of EVs.

items.title: The 'debasement trade' returns after Bessent bond maneuver. Crypto and gold are back in style
items.description: Concern over the size and the cost of U.S. government spending has given new life to the debasement trade.

items.title: OpenAI bans Russian ChatGPT accounts used in covert misinformation campaign
items.description: The AI company said the incident "illustrates how influence actors can use AI as a supporting tool within a broader effort to manufacture authority."

items.title: New Delhi draws in $73 billion in 11 weeks, powered by special deposits for non-resident Indians
items.description: India has attracted inflows of $73 billion in 11 weeks, driven mostly by foreign currency bank deposits made by non-resident Indians.

items.title: Ukraine is targeting Russia’s retail giants. Ozon is the next economic pressure point
items.description: Kyiv says the attacks are aimed at disrupting Russian supply chains and inflicting further pressure on Putin's wartime economy.

items.title: BlackBerry CEO says robotics is one of its fastest-growing businesses
items.description: BlackBerry CEO John Giamatteo says robotics is one of QNX’s fastest-growing businesses as the company expands its software beyond cars.

items.title: Dragon Ball Z theme park gets $7 billion green light
items.description: French President Emmanuel Macron and Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman agree on a $7 bn investment in the anime theme park.

items.title: Lego posts record first-half revenue, CEO touts strong sales at high-end and value pricing
items.description: Lego CEO Niels Christiansen told CNBC the company is seeing strong sales at both ends of the pricing spectrum.

items.title: Trump targets Iran’s trade lifelines — here are the countries most exposed
items.description: Washington's threat of "economic D-Day" collides with a small group of governments that account for most of what remains of Iran's foreign trade.

items.title: Xpeng shares sink as weak delivery forecast overshadows $6.3 billion robot unit valuation
items.description: Xpeng shares slid after weak delivery guidance, even as its nascent robotics business secured a valuation nearly matching that of its core EV business.

items.title: Porsche inks $1.5 billion deal for AI deployment with India’s largest IT services firm Tata Consultancy
items.description: Indian IT services giant TCS has secured a $1.5 billion contract to deploy AI for German sports carmaker Porsche.

items.title: Paramount CEO David Ellison is at the final hurdle before buying WBD. So far, he can't clear it
items.description: An antitrust challenge by a group of state attorneys general has left Paramount CEO David Ellison hunting for avenues to get his deal for WBD done.

items.title: Main Street Sports sues Comcast, Charter for underpaid licensing fees
items.description: Main Street has been in the process of winding down its portfolio of regional sports networks since the the NHL and NBA seasons ended earlier this year.

items.title: Trump says U.S. will hike Canada auto tariffs to 50% as trade war escalates
items.description: President Donald Trump said the U.S. will raise tariffs on imports of cars, trucks and auto parts from Canada to 50% on Jan. 1, 2027.

items.title: Mark Walter's TWG Global hires Goldman veteran Markowitz as top lawyer amid probe of insurers
items.description: Federal authorities are investigating how two insurers that are part of Mark Walter's business empire classified more than $20 billion in loans to his companies.
